custom_inventwo_migration_intro: This assistant converts the old widgets of the vis-1 adapter "vis-inventwo" (i-vis-*) in a vis-2 project into the vis-2 widgets of this adapter. The project must already be imported into vis-2.
custom_inventwo_migration_risk_1: The result is not pixel perfect. Common widgets are converted completely, others only partly – you get a list of everything to check by hand.
custom_inventwo_migration_risk_2: Only inventwo widgets are converted. Widgets of other adapters stay as they are.
custom_inventwo_migration_risk_3: Close the vis-2 editor of the project first. An open editor may overwrite the result when it saves.
custom_inventwo_migration_risk_4: The safest way is to write the result into a new project. If you convert a project in place, a backup of its vis-views.json is saved first.

custom_inventwo_migration_support_note_v: some list styles do not exist
custom_inventwo_migration_support_note_t: columns, formats and colors are taken over; check the look
custom_inventwo_migration_support_droppe: Not available in vis-2 and therefore dropped: closing a dialog via a separate data point, the matrix arrangement of radio buttons, thresholds per table cell, the rotation of sliders.
custom_inventwo_migration_target_help_op: Optional. Leave empty to convert the project itself.
custom_inventwo_migration_target_exists: A vis-2 project with this name already exists.
custom_inventwo_migration_target_invalid: Only letters, digits, "-" and "_" are allowed.
custom_inventwo_migration_warn_overwrite: Without a name the project "%s" itself is overwritten. A backup of its vis-views.json is saved in the project folder first.
custom_inventwo_migration_info_copy: The project "%s" stays unchanged. It is copied with all its files to "%s" and converted there.
custom_inventwo_migration_preview_text: The analysis changes nothing. It shows what the migration would do.
custom_inventwo_migration_summary: %s views, %s widgets, %s of them old inventwo vis-1 widgets.
custom_inventwo_migration_nothing: There are no old inventwo vis-1 widgets in this project.
custom_inventwo_migration_confirm_overwr: %s widgets in project "%s" are converted. The project is overwritten; a backup of vis-views.json is saved in the project folder before. Is the vis-2 editor of this project closed?
custom_inventwo_migration_confirm_new: The vis-2 project "%s" is created and %s widgets are converted. The source stays unchanged.
custom_inventwo_migration_done_overwrite: %s widgets in project "%s" were converted. Backup: %s
custom_inventwo_migration_done_new: The vis-2 project "%s" was created. Converted widgets: %s, copied files: %s.
custom_inventwo_migration_done_hint_over: Reload vis-2 and check the widgets listed below. To undo, replace vis-views.json with the backup file (tab "Files" in admin).
custom_inventwo_migration_done_hint_new: Reload vis-2, open the new project in the project dialog and check the widgets listed below.
custom_inventwo_migration_reference_help: Only used as reference. When vis-2 imports a vis-1 project, it loses the widgets that were shown in several views. If the original project is selected here, they are restored from it.
custom_inventwo_migration_restore_summar: %s widgets that were shown in several views are restored from the vis-1 project (%s of them are missing completely in the vis-2 project).
custom_inventwo_migration_multiview_summ: %s widgets that are shown in several views are converted to the vis-2 notation (otherwise vis-2 would remove them).
custom_inventwo_migration_disclaimer: The migration was built with care, but there is no guarantee that it works flawlessly for every project – vis-1 projects come in too many different shapes for that. If something is not converted as expected, we are happy to hear about it:
